title: Choosing a stack for a tiny side project

messages.content: I want to build a tiny CLI that turns markdown files into a Graphify-style graph. What stack would you pick?
For a tiny CLI, keep it to Node + TypeScript and avoid frameworks. You get fast startup, easy distribution via npm, and the ecosystem you already know.
How do I keep it simple on testing?
Vitest for everything. One config file, fast watch mode, and it handles ESM without ceremony.
